description: This file declares the 'Stop' class, which implements the 'IPlayerTask' interface for stopping a generic player within the Rialto server's task system. It includes references to context and player interfaces, and defines the constructor, destructor, and execute method.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A class representing a task to stop the generic player, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with the given context and player references.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the stop task, performing the necessary actions to stop the player.
